name: Hex nuts
description: A jar of mixed hex nuts. Toolboxes are full of them; the Workbench always wants more.

name: Adjustable wrench
description: Heavy steel wrench. Opens valves, and doors that won't.

name: Power cord
description: Computer power cable, pulled from a dead PC.

name: Bleach
description: A litre of chlorine bleach. The Lavatory and the Medstation clean with it.

name: Sewing kit
description: Needles, thread and buttons in a biscuit tin. Ragman likes these.

name: Pressure gauge
description: Brass manometer off a boiler line. The Water Collector needs one.

name: Multitool
description: Folding pliers, blades and drivers in one. Skier pays well for a good one.

name: RAM module
description: A stick of server memory. Mechanic builds his rigs from them.

name: Medical blood set
description: Sterile IV line and needle in a sealed pack. The Medstation and Therapist want them.

name: Propane tank
description: Five kilos of propane in a dented bottle. Cooks food, and other things.

name: Cordless drill
description: Battery drill with a case of bits. Every Workbench needs one.

name: VHF radio transmitter
description: Army handheld radio. Its guts make good Intelligence Center parts.

name: Ophthalmoscope
description: Clinic eye scope with a lit head. Medics and opticians both want it.

name: Thermite charge
description: Burns through locks and engine blocks. Handle with care.

name: Server blade
description: A full server on one board, pulled from a rack. Bitcoin farm material.

name: Portable defibrillator
description: Field AED in a hard case. Therapist trades her best kits for one.

name: Military gyroscope
description: Fibre-optic gyro from a missile guidance unit.

name: Thermal imaging module
description: The sensor core of a thermal scope. Worth more than most rifles.

name: Encrypted field transmitter
description: Frequency-hopping military radio with its crypto module intact.

name: Military tank battery
description: A tank's starter battery. Crushingly heavy, and it could run a hideout for a month.
